title: Pokemon TCG Korean Grimmsnarl 054/069 Eevee Heroes Holo Rare
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare Pokémon card features the beloved Eevee character in a heroic Grimmsnarl stage. With a stunning holo finish, this card is a must-have for any serious collector of the Pokémon Trading Card Game. The card is written in Korean and is numbered 054/069 R S6a. 

Perfect for fans of the Pokémon TCG, this card is a great addition to any collection. The Stage 2 Grimmsnarl card is a powerful creature that is sure to impress any opponent. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare and sought-after card.
